# Oct 6, 2026

Manage your full client and revenue lifecycle from proposals and engagement letters to work delivery, invoicing, and payments, all through Karbon.

**Jump to section:**

- [ENGAGEMENTS](https://karbonhq.com/release-notes/oct-6-2026/#engagements-43a6c020b8144bcab1a1e3fcc61aa855)

ENGAGEMENTS

## Win clients. Deliver work. Get Paid. All in Karbon.

Starting today, Engagements is available in your Karbon account. More than a standalone proposal or engagement letter tool, it connects every signed agreement to the work, billing, and payments that follow.

![](https://fast.wistia.com/embed/medias/hp08z4flqi/swatch)

![](https://embed-ssl.wistia.com/deliveries/3ffc15ae01fead0aeaaba70d2b8dbaa7.webp?image_crop_resized=1920x1080)

Click for sound

**What you can do with Engagements:**

- Build reusable engagement templates that accelerates client onboarding

- Create engagements in bulk using your full client list or specific client segments

- Collect client payment details during signing

- Turn each signed engagement into scoped work (one time or recurring) with teams and deadlines assigned

- Automate recurring invoicing, issue invoices on your schedule, and collect on the terms you set

- Reprice, roll forward, or renew each year from the engagements already in Karbon


If you’re a billing admin, you’ll see a new Engagements tab in your navigation menu when you log in. If you’re not, you can request access from your account admins.

Ready to get started? Join one of our weekly complimentary Engagements onboarding sessions and office hours to set up engagements in your account with expert guidance. [Save your spot](https://karbonhq.com/group-onboarding-cohorts/engagements-onboarding/).

Prefer to learn at your own pace? Watch these short [video tutorials](https://help.karbonhq.com/s/articles/2000297-create-send-activate-engagements-video-walkthrough), take the free Karbon Academy courses, or deep dive through the [Help Center](https://help.karbonhq.com/s/topic/0TORh00000044hlOAA/engagements).
